about.imageAlt: Volunteers distributing supplies in a rural community
about.quote: “The well changed everything. My daughters walk to school now instead of to the river.”
about.tagline: Hope, delivered where it’s needed most.
about.description: Working together to create lasting change and improve lives in our community.
about.paragraph: HopeBridge exists to close the distance between generosity and need. We work directly with local partners — not layers of bureaucracy — so that what you give arrives as clean water, a classroom, a clinic visit, or a meal, not as overhead.
about.stat1: Local partner organizations on the ground

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: Amana Charity & Edir works to alleviate suffering and provide support to the most vulnerable members of our community through transparent, accountable, and impactful aid programs.
mission.p2: We believe that everyone deserves access to basic necessities, healthcare, and opportunities to improve their lives, regardless of their circumstances.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.p1: We envision a society where all community members have their basic needs met, with equal access to healthcare, education, and economic opportunities.
vision.p2: Through our community-centered approach, we aim to build resilient neighborhoods where people support each other and grow together.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.desc: We maintain complete openness in our operations, finances, and decision-making processes.

compassion.title: Compassion
compassion.desc: We approach our work with empathy and respect for the dignity of those we serve.

community.title: Community
community.desc: We believe in the power of communities working together to solve shared challenges.

cta.title: Join Our Mission
cta.subtitle: Whether through donations, volunteering, or spreading awareness, your support makes a meaningful difference in the lives of those we serve.

stats.card1: Families raising children who have lost one or both parents
stats.card2: Single mothers raising their children on their own, with our steady support
stats.card3: Families living with disability or long-term illness, never left behind
stats.card4: Elderly families without a steady income, cared for with dignity
